column1: Executive Management Committee (EXCOM),Assets and Liabilities Committee ALCO

The Committee meets regularly and at least
monthly to discuss:
• strategy formulation and implementation;
• support the Group Managing Director in the
overall management of the Bank’s business;
• provide strategic oversight to the positioning
of the Bank in all the business segments it
operates in;
• policy and procedure formulation for
appropriate internal control;
• financial performance against the approved
strategy and budgets;
• review of strategic and operational plans for
purposes of realizing the Group’s strategy; and
• compliance with the regulatory framework and
guidelines and adherence to Group policies and
procedures.
The Committee also serves as a link between the
Board and Management in ensuring that the Board
is apprised of key matters affecting the running of
the Group.,"The Committee meets monthly or more frequently
depending on the business circumstances to:
• ensure that all foreseeable funding
commitments can be met as and when they fall
due
• develop and implement the Bank’s liquidity and
funding strategy and policy
• review and manage operational risks pertaining
to interest rate, market and exchange rate risks
• review the Bank’s balance sheet and liability
mix and recommend changes where applicable
• ensure compliance with statutory requirements
governing liquidity, cash ratio and foreign
exchange exposure
• consider investment policies, and the internal
capital adequacy management program.
The Committee provides a source of key
information that informs considerations at Executive
Management Committee and Board Executive
Committee"
Management Credit Risk Committee (MCRC),Innovations Committees

The Committee meets monthly to:
• review and approve new credit applications and
renewals within the delegated limits set by the
Board;
• recommend to the Board Credit Risk Committee
(BCRC) proposals on the revision of limits;
• ensure compliance with regulatory limits related
to lending;
• monitor, review and consider and issues that
may materially impact on the quality of the
Bank’s credit risk management; and
• recommend to the BCRC facilities for approval
that fall within the limits reserved for Board
approval.
All approvals and recommendations originating
from the Committee are independent of the
originating business unit(s).
The Committee provide a source of key information
that informs considerations at the Board Credit Risk
Committee.,"The Committee meets regularly to review:
• the innovation strategy in view of the Group’s
strategies and plans
• key threats and opportunities resulting
from innovation trends, industry issues and
technology
• review and advice on company research and
development expenditure plans
• monitor and evaluate performance of the
company’s initiatives in support of its innovation
strategy
• review updates on material acquisitions,
dispositions and long term commitments in
relation to the company’s innovation strategy.
The Committees provide a source of key
information that informs considerations at
EXCOM and Board ICT Committee."
